text: Cleaned PJM East hourly load data from 2002 to Aug 2018 by averaging 4 duplicate daylight-saving timestamps, interpolating 30 missing hours, and keeping 27 extreme-load hours as genuine heat-wave peaks

Tested stationarity of the load series with KPSS and ADF and used differencing; found daily seasonality explains far more variance than weekly, and that weekends average about 9.7% lower than weekdays (Cohen's d 0.73)
Built day-ahead (24-hour) electricity load forecasts with LightGBM, LSTM and SARIMA, evaluated on a strict time-based split from 1 Jan to 3 Aug 2018 (5,136 hours)

Found my first LightGBM used fewer recent inputs than the LSTM, which made the LSTM look 25% better; after giving both the same information they were statistically tied (Diebold-Mariano style test, p = 0.90), and a simple average of both was slightly but significantly better (p < 0.02)
Ensemble of LightGBM and LSTM reached MAE 1,467 MW, RMSE 2,113 MW and MAPE 4.40% on the test period, versus MAE 2,531 MW and MAPE 7.91% for a same-hour-yesterday naive baseline

Evaluated SARIMA (period 24) on the first 30 test days only: MAE 1,813 MW versus 2,735 MW for the naive baseline (34% lower), within about 4% of LightGBM but behind the LSTM; published the project on GitHub
Prepared the PhiUSIIL phishing URL dataset (235,795 URLs, 235,370 after removing 425 duplicates) and split features into three groups: URL (19), page consistency (10) and browser behavior (8)

Excluded three dataset columns (URLSimilarityIndex, TLDLegitimateProb, URLCharProb) because they are computed from other URLs in the dataset and could inflate results; evaluated Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, Random Forest and XGBoost on an 80/20 stratified split (47,074 test URLs)

Built a hybrid phishing detector with XGBoost on all 37 features that cut missed phishing URLs from 104 to 13 (about 87% fewer) versus a URL-only baseline, raising F1 from 0.9972 to 0.9995 and accuracy from 0.9976 to 0.9996
Ran a feature ablation showing almost all of the improvement came from page-consistency features, while browser-behavior features alone gave no improvement over URL-only features

Analysed the hybrid model's errors: 13 missed phishing pages and 8 wrongly flagged legitimate pages; missed phishing pages looked like normal content-rich sites, and the groups were small so findings are indications, not proof
Built a Streamlit app for the phishing detection system and wrote a research paper on it
Built the OTT Intelligence System to predict customer churn and content popularity, with a Streamlit app
Built the Nike Instagram post analytics project with a dual-pipeline analytics approach for the Social Media Analytics course
Built a Hinglish sentiment classifier on video comments and compared VADER, XLM-R Twitter, fine-tuned multilingual DistilBERT and TF-IDF with logistic regression

On 5 held-out videos (319 comments), TF-IDF with logistic regression reached macro F1 0.699 versus 0.410 for VADER and 0.535 for XLM-R Twitter, and was statistically indistinguishable from fine-tuned DistilBERT (0.650); grouped cross-validation gave a lower 0.584, so the result is partly a favourable split
Built the Cloud Cover Detective image analytics case study to detect clouds and shadows in satellite images and compute a usability score
Rebuilt all Google Advanced Data Analytics Certificate projects from scratch locally
Built the career-log resume builder: Python CLI, JSONL log, Chroma semantic search, and LLM bullet generation with source citations
